q: Change the voice of the following sentence: Plumeria smells sweet.
o: Plumeria is sweet when it smelled.
Plumeria is sweet when it is being smelled.
Plumeria is sweet when it is smelled.
Plumeria is sweet when it smells.
e: Plumeria smells sweet-এ smell ক্রিয়াটি active হলেও অর্থে passive, এ ধরনের বাক্যকে quasi-passive বলে। এর passive করতে subject একই থাকে, তারপর be verb ও adjective, এরপর when it/they এবং be verb-সহ মূল verb-এর past participle বসে। তাই Plumeria is sweet when it is smelled শুদ্ধ। Being smelled-এ চলমান ভাব আসায় অর্থ বদলে যায়।

q: The correct passive form of: Who will teach us English?

By whom English will be taught?
By whom we will be taught English?

q: Who broke the window? (Make it passive)
o: By whom was the window broken?
Who was the window broken by?
The window was broken by whom?
Both ক & খ
e: Who দিয়ে শুরু প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যকে passive করার দুটি নিয়ম আছে: By whom + was/were + object + V3? এবং Who + was/were + object + V3 + by? তাই Who broke the window?-এর passive হতে পারে By whom was the window broken? এবং Who was the window broken by? দুটিই শুদ্ধ। The window was broken by whom? এই বিন্যাস প্রচলিত নয়।
